# MH Photography

> Edmonton-based wedding and family photographer + videographer specializing in Indian and South Asian weddings — 50+ Sikh, Hindu, Muslim, and interfaith ceremonies covered by one team that delivers both documentary photography and cinematic video.

Last updated: 2026-05

MH Photography is run by Moein Habibi (Moe) from Edmonton, Alberta. 15+ years behind the camera, 200+ weddings documented, 50+ Indian and South Asian ceremonies covered, 5.0 Google rating. Photography and cinematic video are delivered by one team — not subcontracted, not borrowed second shooters — so the photographer and videographer never fight for the same shot. Transparent public pricing: Photography $2,250 · Videography $3,750 · Photo + Video $8,750 · Family $400. Currently booking 2026 and 2027.

The Edmonton market is unusual: most Indian-wedding coverage in Alberta is handled either by generalist photographers shooting one South Asian wedding per year, or by Toronto and Vancouver studios that fly in. MH Photography is the Edmonton-based local specialist — deep multi-faith South Asian experience and a unified photo + video team — serving Edmonton, all of Alberta, and clients across Canada.

## Services

- [Wedding photography](https://mhphoto.ca/photography/weddings/): Full-day documentary coverage from getting-ready through reception across Alberta — 200+ weddings shot.
- [Indian and South Asian wedding photography](https://mhphoto.ca/photography/indian-weddings/): 50+ Sikh, Hindu, Muslim, and interfaith weddings — multi-day coverage from Mehndi through Reception with cultural fluency in key ceremony moments (Baraat, Anand Karaj, Saptapadi, Vidaai).
- [Family photography](https://mhphoto.ca/photography/family/): Relaxed outdoor sessions across Edmonton's parks and river valley, from $400.
- [Engagement photography](https://mhphoto.ca/photography/engagement/): Natural couple portraits at Edmonton, Banff, and Lake Minnewanka locations.
- [Videography and wedding cinematography](https://mhphoto.ca/videography/): Cinematic wedding films delivered by the same team that shoots the photos — one crew, two cameras, zero crossed sightlines.
- [Elopement photographer Edmonton](https://mhphoto.ca/elopement-photographer-edmonton/): 2-4 hour documentary coverage at river valley, Banff, Jasper, Lake Louise, and Kananaskis locations — 150-300+ edited images, from $2,250.
